decisions.evidence: Overall, the modest molecular weight and the presence of some lipophilic/basic features outweigh the polar liabilities, so the molecule is more consistent with crossing the BBB, although the amide and hydroxyl-rich features make the case less straightforward.
The balance of evidence favors a compound that can still cross the BBB, though not overwhelmingly so because the polar groups create some resistance to passive permeation.
the molecule is predicted to cross the BBB.
